neighbours.label: words naming genetic or inherited disease ('genetic disorders', 'inherited diseases', curing a hereditary condition)
fire: The foundation supports families living with rare genetic conditions.
Huntington's disease is an inherited disorder of the brain.
Doctors screen newborns for several genetic diseases at birth.
The biotech firm wants to cure a hereditary form of blindness.
Some children are born with an inherited metabolic disorder.
Gene therapy could one day fix many genetic disorders of the blood.
Her son has a rare genetic syndrome that affects his muscles.
Haemophilia is an inherited bleeding disorder passed through families.
quiet: The foundation supports families living with long-term injuries.
Tuberculosis is an infectious disease of the lungs.
Doctors screen newborns for several infections at birth.
The biotech firm wants to treat an age-related form of blindness.
Some adults develop a metabolic disorder from poor diet.
New drugs could one day fix many disorders of the blood caused by toxins.
Her son has a sports injury that affects his muscles.
Scurvy is a nutritional disorder caused by a lack of vitamin C.

notes: Card: ' genetic' x7, ' gene', ' inherited', ' cure' in rare-disease contexts; logit effect of the + pole suppresses mutations/inherited/syndrome. Probe: 'rare genetic disorders' 0.83, 'inherited disease' 0.50, infectious disease 0.06.
